reason: Independent source review identified an unsupported converse inference in the frozen complex-expansion rule: a missing annotation was incorrectly described as affirmative true-binary origin.
immutable_history: Original protocol, panel, downloaded blobs, retrieval receipts and preparation receipt remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No reselection, changed split or outcome inspection.

replacement.original: Retain exact expansion method and shared original interaction identifier. Expanded rows are evidence representations, not independent direct-binding experiments. A blank expansion cell is source-default true-binary representation, without upgrading interaction directness.
replacement.corrected: Retain exact supplied expansion method and shared original interaction identifier. Expanded rows are evidence representations, not independent direct-binding experiments. A blank expansion cell (-) means no expansion annotation was supplied; preserve that missing annotation. It does not establish true-binary experimental origin or absence of n-ary expansion. Assert such origin only if supported by additional explicit source evidence; do not infer interaction directness.

effect_on_metrics: The existing expansion-present/absent stratum refers only to source annotation presence. Strict fidelity and unsupported-context error counts must use this amended rule. No metric denominator, eligibility, source selection or study split changes.

evidence.finding: The standard recommends expansion annotation for expanded n-ary data and says true binary records use -. This is not an assertion that every - record has true-binary origin.
Empty expansion collections add no annotation; this method does not set an affirmative binary-origin flag.

required_acknowledgement: Any future interpretation/evaluation must bind the original protocol and this amendment file SHA-256, and replay through the amended preparation guard before opening reference rows. The old artifact-only freeze checker is not a semantic authorization.
